title: Contracts and Audit Logs (Flock Safety) (Colorado Bureau of Investigation)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All Contracts with Flock Safety
Any Contracts, MOU's, Agreements, Written Deals or Assurances, or similar between this agency and Flock Safety or any business representing Flock Safety.

2. Organization Audit in Flock.
The report should include data logged from the period of Jan 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Flock's documentation, the Organization Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches done within the agency.

3. Network Audit in Flock.
The report should include data logged from the period of Jan 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Flock's documentation, the Network Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches of the organization’s Flock network by any agency in the Flock System.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

William Beckett
